5913-8043-8350.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
5913-8043-8350.description:
Cast Face Yourself for free due to Vision, targeting yourself and creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste and the noted exile clause.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Face Yourself from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

5641-8174.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying its mana cost.
When Basking Broodscale enter, Mabel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mabel triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Repeat from step 3.

1365-2198-2527-5294-5686.easyPrerequisites:
Deceiver Exarch doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vohar doesn't have summoning sickness.
1365-2198-2527-5294-5686.description:
Activate Vohar's first ability by tapping it.
Vohar triggers, giving creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Vohar ability from step 1, causing you to loot.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Deceiver Exarch persist until end of turn.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Vohar.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

512-4644-7066.easyPrerequisites: Avatar Kyoshi and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
512-4644-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Avatar Kyoshi, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-4644-7066.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Avatar Kyoshi's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

575-1794-3899.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-1794-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-6797-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-6797-7396.description:
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Quintorius, History Chaser.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

6798-7084-7892.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

360-4017-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-4017-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1368-3755-5295-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-5295-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

703-4089-7149.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Glasspool Mimic enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Glasspool Mimics into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Glasspool Mimic tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-4089-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

104-3490-5231-5870.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-5231-5870.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain life and get {E}
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-3490-4476-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3490-4476-4659.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

1778-2292-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

3921-4968-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Winding Constrictor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
3921-4968-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

2639-3254-4050-5125.manaNeeded: {4}{G/W}{B}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2639-3254-4050-5125.description:
Cast Nethroi either from your hand or from the command zone for its mutate cost by paying {4}{G/W}{B}{B}, putting it under a non-Human creature you control.
Nethroi triggers, returning Sparkcaster and Mitotic Slime from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sparkcaster enters, it triggers, returning Nethroi from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Sparkcaster and Mitotic Slime, adding {B}{B}.
When Mitotic Slime dies, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Oozes, adding {1}{G/W}.
When the Oozes die, they trigger, creating four 1/1 Ooze creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Oozes, adding {3}.
Repeat.
2639-3254-4050-5125.notes: During step 2, you can recur other creatures with suitable powers. This will allow you to forego sacrificing that many Oozes in step 8, netting infinite mana and creature tokens. If you have infinite mana and Oozes, you can then forego reanimating Mitotic Slime and reanimate anything else with a suitable power instead.

413-2086-6824.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station tigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

678-4766-6798.easyPrerequisites: Deathrender attached to a nontoken creature you control.
678-4766-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

4484-4647-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4484-4647-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

3240-4050-5631.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {B}.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1077-2034-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
1077-2034-5434-5555.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-4423-4477-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4423-4477-4872.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

277-1846-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites:
Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
277-1846-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Everywhere.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
High Tide triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

2743-3263-4483.notablePrerequisites: You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-3263-4483.description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Echo Storm triggers, copying it for each time you've cast from the command zone this game, with each copy targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Echo Storms, creating that  make copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

2783-3510-4875.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
"Saproling" chosen with Conspiracy.
2783-3510-4875.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling that is also a Forest land due to Life and Limb and Conspiracy, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
Repeat step 3.
NOTE: This combo creates an infinite mandatory loop that will draw the game if it is not interacted with.

282-1494-4802.notablePrerequisites:
Master Biomancer has power five or greater.
Delina does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
282-1494-4802.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one token copy of Sage of Hours that enters the battlefield with at least five +1/+1 counters due to Master Biomancer.
Activate the Sage of Hours token by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3368-3401.notablePrerequisites:
Artifacts you control can tap to produce at least {5}{R}{R}.
You are able to cast Blinkmoth Infusion.
3368-3401.description:
Cast Blinkmoth Infusion by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of artifacts you control.
Holding priority, activate all mana-producing artifacts you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}{R}{R}.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Blinkmoth Infusion and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Blinkmoth Infusion copy, untapping all artifacts.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-5089-5116.description:
Animate Gilded Lotus using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.
